notes.title: Steam Workshop Support is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/7391b69ed8ab73c0218c19bd83849e6ffd298554.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

This is Double Cross & 2P Games

When we first began crafting Sultan's Game, our goal was simply to streamline story editing for our designers while supporting as many features and combinations as possible. It wasn't until near completion that we realized - perhaps serendipitously - we had crafted an elegantly simple yet remarkably flexible and powerful framework for narrative games. This system minimizes the fundamental units of story construction, allowing developers to focus on crafting individual narratives while freely expanding event complexity and story formulas as resources permit, all seamlessly connected through cards and triggers.
As a development team that has worked extensively with various game editors and frameworks, we can confidently say this is a work we're truly proud of! Moreover, we've been fortunate to prove through Sultan's Game that this storytelling approach has tremendous potential.
 
At the same time, as the framework's most intensive users, we're acutely aware that our current MOD support features - and even the underlying data structures - still have room for improvement. Through community feedback and usage, we'll continue refining these tools and breaking down more game modules to enhance MOD creation freedom, ultimately enabling you to craft entirely new games that are completely different from Sultan's Game.

Therefore, we cordially invite all fellow storytelling enthusiasts to explore the tools we've built in the game's Workshop! As Miss Mahir would say, from that fleeting spark of inspiration to painstaking design, from blood, sweat, and tears in development to creating a complete work...we're just one step away from complete joy - sharing these tools with you. Come join the fun!
 
[u][url=https://www.notion.so/2021b70a5a2380849db6f8776d729b5f?v=2021b70a5a238018bcdf000c53d5c92b]Sultan's Game Data Structure Documentation[/url] (Japanese and English versions in preparation)[/u]
Here's a straightforward guide to game creation that should help everyone get started. Most of the effects you can achieve have examples within the game's own configuration files - and we're committed to developing even more interesting combination mechanics with the spirit of "expanding usage possibilities for everyone"!

Additionally, to foster a healthy community environment, we kindly ask creators to be mindful when developing Mods. Content containing the following elements may need to be reviewed and could potentially be removed to maintain our community standards:[olist]
[*] - Content that conflicts with regional regulations applicable to our development team and the Steam platform, such as political content, inappropriate material involving minors, and similar topics.
[*] - Content that significantly misrepresents characters or storylines in ways that might cause community concern, or material referencing current events and real-world public figures.
[*] - Content incorporating copyrighted assets without proper authorization from rights holders.
[*] - Mods featuring AI-generated content.
[/olist]

notes.title: Sultan's Game: Our First Month and Looking Ahead
notes.content:
Sultan's Game has been live for a month now!

...And what a magical whirlwind it's been!

Time has both raced and crawled, our emotions have soared and dipped, but through it all, we've achieved success beyond our wildest ambitions. The love from our player community has touched us deeply - we cannot thank you enough!

Looking forward, our journey with Sultan's Game continues. Beyond our regular bug fixes, here's what we're crafting for you:
[olist]
[*] Refined Localizations. We're carefully reviewing feedback from our global players to refine our translations. Our exceptional localization specialists are working diligently to ensure both English and Japanese versions resonate authentically with their respective cultures. By July, expect polished, elegant translations that preserve the soul of the narrative while feeling natural to each language.

[*] MOD Support. This significant feature will arrive this May. Please note updates may cause compatibility issues with some MODs. If you encounter related bugs, please try to turn off or uninstall the MOD.

[*] More Plots. We're crafting additional Epilogues for existing endings, developing entirely new endings with their accompanying storylines, and enriching character stories - including Fate Shop unlockables and characters like Samir. Much of this writing is already underway.

[*] Crowdfunded Content. Development is progressing smoothly on the ten player-designed items and the community-voted character. We're on track to integrate these treasures by June!

[*] Visual Enhancements. Ending illustrations, story backgrounds, and some interesting little creations spontaneously developed by our art team - all currently in progress!

[*] Development of the Artbook. We're truly honored by your enthusiasm for this! Publishers have already signed on for the artbook of Sultan's Game, though we're still completing essential materials. Throughout the year, we'll be compiling this collection alongside our regular updates, with plans to offer both physical and digital editions when complete.
[/olist]

Your support continues to humble us. We can only repay this faith through our unwavering dedication to creating the best game possible.

Double Cross & 2P Games

Since the texts are reaching almost 1MM, we are still working on the revision, and we promise to bring you a better experience. We’re also receiving tons of feedback and taking care of it. Expect regular patches!
Here are our planned updates:

[olist]
[*] Quick Execution
For repetitive events like Managing the Estate and Court sessions, we're introducing a new feature called [Quick Execution] that can be manually switched on and off.
Players can switch this on for daily events to skip them in rewarding period.
(Note: Remember to disable this feature when using special cards for storyline-related actions (e.g., requesting consorts at court) to avoid missing critical storyline. Each event has individual toggle control.
[*] Card Organization
We are working on the feature that allows players to assign specific card categories to particular hand slots, and setting hotkeys for automatic organization.
The auto-recommendation feature for event slots will be upgraded to suggest cards across hand rows, rather than being limited to the current row.
[*] Music & Sound Effects
We received a lot of feedback about the music & sound effects. However, comprehensive improvements require longer development cycles.
We'll prioritize optimizing the most disruptive sound effects and musical transitions.
Ongoing adjustments will be rolled out based on community feedback.
[*] Sensitive Content Warning
We are working on new game icons to help identify choices leading to sensitive storylines.
Considering that some players like this kind of unpredictable fun, we put this feature into the Settings, so you can switch it on and off as you wish.
But there are simply too many instances of such content (Skeleton scratching head.gif), and different people have different judgment criteria for “Sensitive”. We are still working on adding these icons but we need more time to make ongoing adjustments based on feedback, adding or removing these icons as needed.
[*] Game Save
We are working on the manual Save/Load feature.
Players can save/load and start from the save point.
However, due to considerations such as save file size limitations, the save point will not support rolling back to earlier ones. And players will still need to start a new game to load new entries in the Fate's Ledger.

notes.title: A note from the dev team regarding Sultan’s Game choices and consequences
notes.content:
Hello,

We are the Double Cross and 2P Games team, creators of the Sultan's Game Project.

Currently, there's an ongoing discussion within the community regarding the content and choices we offer players, and we're here to clarify our intentions. From the inception of the Sultan's Game concept, our goal has been to provide players with significant freedom of choice. Each character is crafted with a distinct personality and background, allowing you to explore the varied outcomes stemming from your decisions. Some of these outcomes may challenge traditional values. 

However, it's important to emphasize that [b]All outcomes are a result of your choices, and you have the ability to avoid any undesired results.[/b] Similar to the overarching theme of The Sultan's Game, we feature diverse characters who express their romantic interests toward the protagonist. You have the freedom to either accept, decline or even capitalize on these advances. Ultimately, the choice is entirely yours.


Regarding the character Faraj, who finds himself amid the tumult, it's essential to note that unlocking his romantic storyline entails meeting specific requirements. However, in every scenario you encounter in the game, you can always say NO, whether to HIM or HER. We do not intend for every player to experience the same storyline without your consent. Even if you decline, Faraj will fully respect your decision.

We believe that “There are a thousand Hamlets in a thousand people 's eyes.” This notion applies to the Sultan's Game as well, as we provide abundant opportunities for you to explore various choices.

We believe that eliminating story elements isn't the appropriate solution, but we are happy to implement notifications to alert you about potential consequences resulting from your actions.

In the meantime, if any aspects of our game do not resonate with your vision, please share your feedback with us via our Steam Community or our Official Discord.

Sincerely,
The Double Cross and 2P Games team

notes.title: Happy New Year & Devlog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/94cb4d7f3a734d4ddeabfb58d7525f13c905a8a9.png[/img]
Dear players,

We're happy to announce that we're joining the Chinese New Year celebration event. Sorry to keep you all waiting for the full version of the game and for the radio silence regarding the development. Believe us, we're working hard on getting everything ready for The Grand Release, stay tuned!

Also, we’d like to share an update on our development progress.

This week, we completed the most complex part of the game: the full story and levels for the “Change the Dynasty”. This is a scenario we’ve dreamed of countless times, and bringing it to life has been both thrilling and exhausting. With so many branches and events packed into this ending, even ourselves can’t exhaustively test every condition. We’re confident that players striving to overthrow tyranny will feel properly rewarded for their efforts.

 As development for Sultan’s Game enters its final phase, we’ve completed the level design for most other ending routes and are continuing to refine the content. Each ending will feature multiple branching storylines, and the workload—writing, scripting, designing—is enormous. But the team remains enthusiastic and determined to deliver a product we can be proud of.

 Meanwhile, we’re diving deeper into the branching storyline centered around the themes of Insights, Cult, The Righteous Path. This is an extensive and standalone plotline leading to its own unique ending. Through gods and their emissaries, we aim to explore some metaphysical ideas. However, as expected, gods are demanding beings. The Pure Ones and the Hidden God are at odds, and you must choose whom to worship—unless your power rivals that of the gods themselves... or you find allies willing to seize the opportunity…

 We’re happy to share that most of character concepts are already complete. We’ll be revealing them gradually on social media soon. The game’s UI and environments have undergone (yet another) round of updates, and many characters’ stories are being implemented now.

 That’s all for this progress report! While the remaining time feels limited for building the perfect story we envision, based on the current progress, we’re confident we can deliver a complete game by the end of Q1.

We hope you are as excited as we are for the official release and we wish you a wonderful Year of the Snake!

notes.title: Future Plans & Insights from the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Double Cross Studio, along with our colleagues from the 2P Games publishing team!

First, we need to thank all players for their attention to 'Sultan's Game'! To be honest, the love that everyone has shown for the game has far exceeded our expectations... Of course, this is a great thing for us as game developers, giving us the motivation and confidence to make the game even better, to match everyone's love and expectations.

Our team will now focus on developing the full version, so don’t expect more updates on the demo. But don’t worry, [u]you can still play it for as long as you want.[/u] Based on the issues discovered, your feedback, and our own game plans, we will focus our future efforts on the following aspects:


[h3]Adding and enhancing the storyline and mechanics of the game [/h3]
[list]
[*] 	More characters will have personal storylines, and new characters will be added. This workload is nearly equivalent to the entire current text volume. We aim to complete most characters' personal stories by the time the game launches; however, we need to balance the development progress with the release date. If these tasks are not fully completed by launch, we will include them in future updates at no additional cost, similar to how Baldur's Gate 3 handled some storylines.
[*] 	The five reputation attributes will have independent mechanics and stories, which will influence the endings and intersect with other characters' personal stories
[*] 	Additional storylines and endings influenced by the gods of good and evil, the Right Path, and the Cultist
[*] 	More random events will be added
[*] 	Some existing events will expand the variety of available Sultan Cards and add corresponding story branches
[*] 	We are also optimizing storyline requirements that rely too heavy on card sequence for certain characters, balancing the cost and reward of joining
[*] 	We’ll improve underutilized mechanisms such as troops and mounts
[/list]
[h3]Interaction experience, art presentation, and system optimization[/h3]
	[list]
[*]    Adding an extra hand organization area and shortcut functions
[*] 	For repeated events, allowing players to record and quickly place cards used in previous round
[*] 	Introducing a powerful mechanic to directly add success dice to outcomes 
[*] 	Dividing the game into three different, selectable difficulty levels
[*] 	Providing more guidance and prompts for basic function buttons
[*] 	Enhancing the sound effects for cards interactions and events
[/list]
[h3]Art-related[/h3]
	[list]
[*] We will continue working to complete the remaining card images. Once the important character portraits are finished, we will share them with everyone on social media
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/3eae61025609e701413d3a16bbd3fa52c260338e.png[/img]
[*] 	We plan to design a more artistic background and card slot distribution for most events to enhance their narratives
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/89f7150dee07ef5ed74d5363e0c87ae789e5cd07.png[/img]
[*] 	As shown in the picture, the Rare Treasures will eventually become part of the map’s decoration and have an independent ritual settlement, instead of being part of an unified and overly complex ritual 
[/list]

[h3]Game Endings[/h3]
	In the final version, the endings will be more substantial. For example, there will be more narrative scenarios and challenges both before and after escape or rebellion. The way the player manages and responds to each character will also play a crucial role in determining the ending, influencing the fate of both the player and their followers, Correspondingly, the conditions for achieving simple endings will be looser. For instance, there will be alternatives to the current Golden Ideological Trend that can meet conditions more easily, but the rebellion endings brought by different Ideological Trends will also vary.
	We will ensure that in at least one or other special endings, players can deal with the Sultan as they wish (It is what he deserves. [strike]And many people have been especially waiting for this... we know[/strike]). Of course, the coherence and flavor of the story remain our top priority, so this won’t be an easy goal to achieve, and certainly not the most interesting ending
	Apart from eradicating all Sultan Cards, rebellion, and escape, the game will also include additional endings... but please allow us to keep this surprise for later

[h3]Publishing, Community Support, and Promotion Activities[/h3]
	[list]
[*] Optimize the quality of translations and add new languages
[*] 	For future versions, organize small-scale playtesting subsequently
[*] 	Establish communication channels with WIKI contributors, strategy authors, and broadcasters among others, to support these community contributors.
[/list]
[h3]Multi-platform and control support[/h3]
	[list]
[*] The game will be Steam Deck verified and include a Mac version, possibly before or shortly after the release.
[*] 	After the game release, we’ll consider the possibility of porting the game to consoles like Nintendo Switch, but as of now, this will have to wait until after the game is completed to be included in the schedule.
[*] 	Similarly, we do look forward to a mobile version of Sultan’s Game, but it faces more complex challenges than console platforms, so this remains a post-completion consideration.
[/list]

[h3]Workshop support and development guide[/h3]
During the Steam Next Fest, we were shocked to discover players creating simple mods - by cracking our game... The Sultan will (nicely) punish you!
[list]
[*] 	After the game's release, we will provide modding support and tools, allowing players to switch between different mods without damaging the game's files.
[*] 	Additionally, based on community suggestions, we will release more detailed explanations of the game’s system structures and storytelling methods in an accessible format. This will not only offer players more convenience but also allow us to share the excitement of the game development process.
[/list]

[h3]About launch time[/h3]
[u]We aim to release the game in the first quarter of 2025.[/u]
However, given the overwhelming player interest, we’ve undeniably raised our production goals, expanding the game’s content to include more refined systems, large and beautifully stunning monuments, improve music and sound effects… and for many minor characters —good news: you’ll have more personal stories added; bad news: those stories are, well, hehe...

To set expectations, we can’t promise there won’t be any delays. That said, as a small team working on a single-player game for the first time, we’re considering releasing it in Early Access. Many players have told us that the demo already is an EA, tho... But we have to focus on completing what we have, bringing the game to a near-final state and then, after internal testing and further discussions with the player community, we’ll determine the most appropriate release strategy.

[h3]Producer's closing remarks[/h3]
[i]The Atul language has some intriguing terms. One such was the notion of uzan-iya, which was what they called the moment when an innocent heart first contemplated the act of murder. To the Atul, the crime itself was secondary to this initial corruption. Carolyn found that idea—and its implications—fascinating.[/i].                                   ——Scott Hawkins, [b]The Library at Mount Char [/b]
(a very interesting novel, which happens to be a gift I received from the Sultan’s script writer several years ago)

This idea deeply attracted me.
If we repeatedly simulate the moment when a soul becomes stained, won't we have a greater chance to observe the shape of our own soul? Sultan’s Game emerges from such an experiment.
When the soul declines, the cries are mournful, and the blaze is dazzling enough to illuminate the true self and foster self-enlightenment.

Interestingly, almost everyone, including team members, has contradictory and divided opinions about this game. One of the struggles and joys of the producer is standing at the center of the project where all contradictions converge.

On the same day, I heard two different people say to me separately, "Absolutely no man will play this game" and "Absolutely no woman will play this game" (of course, there were many more extreme comments that are better left unsaid).

I also encountered a colleague who, in the morning would defend moral integrity with all their soul, claiming to be a righteous person who would never write such an awful plot; and by the afternoon, came to me wanting to add a killing/indulgence option to another event.

This is not sarcasm; in fact, this is the shape of our soul, which is neither smooth, solid, flat nor symmetrical. We are rugged, full of impurities, with caves and pores, like grotesque, misshapen fruits. We are also sculpted by life, destiny, public opinion, and trends—just as rocks can be shaped by earth, wind, and water, but also polished by skillful or clumsy artisans.

From the chaotic sediment, we can discover the true shapes of all beings. Observe the radiance bursting from these unpolished gems in the intense light of the soul's burning. See the multi-colored glories refracted from the swirling mortal dust... Such an endless joy that we’re looking forward to appreciating with you.

Everything lies within Sultan’s Game.

Double Cross Studio
